四级汇总词汇 · 39英文原文

The Bag Left in the Sun

被放在太阳下的药袋 · 646 词 · 8 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1A pharmacy offered home delivery for patients who could not travel in hot weather. Its clerk, Rin, checked a prescription for a woman with diabetes. The order included medication, a nutrition leaflet, and a supplement prescribed after a deficiency. The package reached the right address, but the patient found it in sunlight beside the door. She called before taking a pill she was unsure about. A technician asked her to keep the bag and wait for the pharmacist to review the storage instructions.

2The label gave different directions for a sealed bottle and an opened one. A driver read only the outer sticker. Another bag contained treatment for an infectious rash, with a separate storage rule. The two bags looked alike. Rin asked him to describe the delivery. He had set one bag outside after seeing a message about a dental appointment. He had not realized the patient might be away longer. A concern about prevention had become a problem of handover.

3The pharmacist checked whether heat could affect the product. The patient used liver medicine too. She asked if the patient had dizziness, a sore stomach, or an unusual change in appetite. A clinician could judge whether any symptom needed an immediate response. The patient wanted a reliable replacement. She already adjusted her diet after a cholesterol test and did not want to repeat a whole day of arrangements. Rin confirmed a time. The pharmacist checked the dosage and the prescription, not the patient's weight or fitness.

4The leaflet covered hygiene, swelling, and a reminder about a vaccine. It also asked patients to report an allergic reaction or a persistent cough. A long list had buried the only storage line. Rin gave it a separate card. A clinic could discuss an outbreak or immunize a patient during a visit. The delivery worker needed a clear handover instruction. Patients with limited health literacy could use the new card without guessing which illness it described.

5A test delivery exposed a broken bell. The resident had poor eyesight and a relative abroad. The pharmacist asked her to choose a local contact. That person could receive a package without seeing personal details about a swollen limb, kidney disease, pregnancy, or mental therapy. A delivery record could show permission and time. It had no need to include a diagnosis or the reason someone could not leave home.

6A nurse proposed checking two more examples. One patient expected a delivery connected with influenza vaccination. Another had dietary advice after an occupational health check for obesity. Neither needed the driver to know the details. A clinical note could guide staff if a fever or an infected cut had delayed the visit. The delivery card could simply give the contact and the time. The test showed how a pharmacy could protect privacy while helping patients obtain what they needed.

7The next week a woman with a muscle injury asked a family member to collect her medicine. A delivery worker checked the written permission before leaving with an insulated bag. The pharmacist added a precautionary line about contacting the clinic if the delay caused anxiety. Someone with an immune disorder could face isolation. The team had no need to collect details of addiction or difficulty controlling alcohol use. The delivery service did not need to administer treatment or collect more details about suffering. It needed to record the handover without making neglect of one instruction harder to discover.

8The original patient brought back the old label. Rin put it beside the new card. The old one mentioned vitamins, remedies, and the effect of sleepiness on a daily routine. The new one began with one action at the door. Its clear message improved awareness without making a promise about a cure. The patient could repeat it and tell the next person who would be home. Rin left the long leaflet available for a separate conversation.

四级汇总词汇 · 39中文译文

被放在太阳下的药袋

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1天气热时，一家药房为不方便出门的患者送药上门。店员琳核对了一位糖尿病患者的处方。包里有药、营养说明单，以及因营养不足而开的补充剂。包裹送到了正确地址，但患者发现它放在门边的太阳底下。她对其中一片药有疑问，服用前打了电话。药房技术人员请她保留药袋，等药师核对保存说明。

2标签上，未开封的瓶子和已经打开的瓶子有不同的保存要求。司机只看了外面的贴纸。另一袋是治疗传染性皮疹的药，也有自己的保存规则。两个袋子看起来一样。琳请司机回想送药过程。他看到一条说患者去看牙的留言，就把一袋药放在门外，没想到患者可能晚很久才回家。原本是为了预防出问题，最后要解决的却是怎么当面交接。

3药师核对了高温可能带来的影响。患者还在用治疗肝脏疾病的药。药师问她是否头晕、胃痛，或食欲有异常变化。哪些症状需要立刻处理，可以由临床医护人员判断。患者只想拿到可靠的替换药。胆固醇检查后，她已经在调整饮食，希望不用把这一天的安排再做一遍。琳敲定了时间。药师核对剂量和处方，没有询问她的体重和体能。

4说明单谈了卫生、肿胀，还提醒接种疫苗。上面也请患者报告过敏反应或持续咳嗽。唯一一条关于保存的内容埋在长长的清单里。琳把它单独印在一张卡上。诊所可以在就诊时谈疫情或为患者接种疫苗。送药人员需要的是一句清楚的交接指示。患者即使对医疗用语不熟，也能用新卡片弄清下一步。

5一次试送发现，有户人家的门铃坏了。住户视力不好，一位亲属又在国外。药师请她选一个本地联系人。这样对方可以代收药包，至于四肢肿胀、肾病、怀孕或心理治疗之类的个人情况，仍由住户自己掌握。送药记录可以写下授权和时间。诊断和不能出门的原因可以留给医护人员。

6一位护士建议再试两个例子。一位患者等着收与流感疫苗接种有关的物品，另一位在职业健康检查发现肥胖后收到了饮食建议。司机只需要知道交接安排。要是发烧或伤口感染耽误了就诊，临床记录可以供医护人员参考。送药卡只写联系人和时间就够了。这次测试说明，药房可以照顾患者的隐私，也能让他们顺利拿到所需物品。

7下一周，一位肌肉受伤的女士请家人代收药。送药人员带着保温袋出发前，先核对书面授权。药师还加了一条提醒，如果因为延迟而感到焦虑，可以联系诊所。患免疫系统疾病的人可能需要隔离。至于是否有成瘾问题、能否控制饮酒，工作人员无须了解。送药服务要把交接记清楚，让人能及时发现有没有漏掉哪一条指示。治疗和病情由医护人员处理。

8第一位患者后来带回了旧标签。琳把它放在新卡旁。旧标签提到维生素、疗法，还说困倦会怎样影响日常生活。新卡开头只写一件事，到门口该怎么交接。清楚的话能提醒人们该做什么，也不会让人误以为药房承诺了治愈。患者能复述，也能告诉下次在家的那个人。琳继续保留完整的说明单，等另外有需要时再谈。
